race.comment: CLIMB THE LADDER (1) was super here fresh when rattling home from last to finish a length away in third. Is drawn to settle closer this time and keeps Newman's 3kg claim. Can get the job done. VEOMAS (8) finally broke through last start and did so in style when leading all of the way here. This is obviously tougher but he's fitter now and is drawn to find the front again. REWRITE (3) couldn't quite keep up with them fresh in testing conditions at Eagle Farm. Fitter now and has more to offer. Can fill a minor slot. SIR ARROGONCE (9) was very impressive when shedding his maiden tag before the break. This looks short of his best but he strips fitter for two trials and reunites with Maloney. Keeping safe.
